steps.speaker: Hifumi Yamada
steps.text:
Damn, I was totally looking forward to that nap, too.
Why'd they have to go and kill the mood?

steps.speaker: Hifumi Yamada
steps.text: W-Wait for me! I wanna go with you!

steps.speaker: Hifumi Yamada
steps.text: That is that, then. I will see you all there.

steps.speaker: Hifumi Yamada
steps.text: N-Not that anyone cares, but I-I'm gonna go, too...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Everyone took off for the gym, but I was frozen where
I stood.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>That uneasy feeling I'd had before... I couldn't get
it out of my mind.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And it looked like I wasn't the only one...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: This...this doesn't seem right.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Yeah, that announcement was totally weird.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Maybe, but just staying put doesn't mean we'll be
safe.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Besides, aren't you guys just a little bit curious to
find out what's going on around here?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
If we do not move forward, we learn nothing.
The only choice is to push ahead.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I...I guess she's right.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But still... I'm kinda—no, really nervous.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>We don't have a choice. We have to go.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: They said to go to the gym, right?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Something weird *is* going on here, right? It's not
just me?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
What was with that announcement? It was like,
totally creepy...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
I know how you feel, but...all we can do now is check
it out, right?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
True. If we do not move forward, we learn nothing. The
only choice is to push ahead.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Wh-What the hell? Is this some kind of bad joke!?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Are you okay? Is everyone okay?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Shit! What the hell kind of game are they playing!?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
I really don't get any of this, but I guess we'd
better just go!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>There's a TV...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>The school *is* funded by the national government,
so I guess it's not that weird to have TVs in here...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Something feels...off. I wonder what it is...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:

<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Holy cow, what's with this huge metal hatch?
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It looks like the kind of thing you'd see in a secret
military base or something...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>This *is* the same main hall I was in before, right?
This door definitely wasn't here then, though...
<CLT>

steps.text:

<CLT>

steps.text:
<CLT 4>But there's no way that's a real gun...right?
